name: task-create-base-branch-seed
title: task.py create records the current branch as the PR target
description: task_store.py:296 records the branch the author is standing on as a new task's base_branch, but the field means the branch a future pull request will target. Those coincide only when a task is created from the default branch, and the SD flow gives every task scaffold its own branch because the review preflight permits at most one Trellis task directory per diff. A survey of active records shows 43 of 45 name main and two name a feature branch, including one merged on 2026-07-30 that went unnoticed for a week. The deterministic gate does not catch it: the preflight requires base_branch to be non-empty and to differ from branch, but a fresh record has branch null, and the rule constraining base_branch to a parent's target applies only to child tasks. PR #342 reached a paid Copilot round with the wrong value after passing preflight with 0 failures.
